text.en: Dog owners consistently praise the salon team for their warm manners, clear communication, and accommodating customer care. Clients note that groomers are patient when discussing coat requirements and make both owners and their pets feel at home. Longtime patrons commend the steady reliability and friendly atmosphere provided at the Kensal Rise parlour.

Clients are delighted with the grooming finishes, noting that dogs return fluffy, clean, and smelling wonderful after baths and hand-stripping sessions. Reviewers appreciate neat trims on various breeds, including cockapoos and terriers. While one corgi owner found the rear coat shaved too hastily, the vast majority describe consistently neat and attractive grooming results.

Clients appreciate the parlour's efficient scheduling and quick turnaround times for grooming and bath sessions. Reviewers mention that staff accommodate last-minute bookings and short-notice emergencies for muddy or anxious dogs. Pet parents value having appointments completed within promised timeframes without keeping dogs waiting unnecessarily.

q.en: Does Just Barking accommodate elderly or anxious dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the team arranges quiet appointments and works gently to minimise stress for nervous, deaf, or senior pets.

q.en: What grooming services are offered at Just Barking?

a.en: The parlour provides full grooming, bath and fluff drying, breed trims, deshedding treatments, and hand stripping for terriers.

q.en: Is parking available when dropping off pets?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that the Chamberlayne Road location features convenient parking for quick drop-offs and collections.

q.en: Are prices competitive for dog grooming in Brent?

a.en: Reviewers describe the fees as very fair and competitive compared to other salons in north-west London.
